notes.title: Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Explorers!
[/h3]We have switched to UE5! We made the decision to switch engines last week after a lot of consideration and research. 
If you'd like to see the full blog post on this announcement, you can view that here: [url=https://socksandgoats.com/blog/unreal-engine-5]https://socksandgoats.com/blog/unreal-engine-5[/url]

[h3]Also, you might be missing out on more updates![/h3]
We also send out our updates through email usually first. If you'd like to get updates on Project Canopy and see our Roadmap and more, you can sign up here: [url=https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy]https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy[/url]

notes.title: Survival Tips for the Demo
notes.content:
Need help surviving in the Canopy?

We just published a Survival Guide to help those that are having a hard time, are stuck on something, or just want to learn more about the details of the game.

The Survival Guide talks about Oxygen, navigating the Inventory and Containers, and more. 

[url=https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy-survival-guide]https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy-survival-guide[/url]

notes.title: 🔴 LIVE: Q&A with Dev / Demo Playthrough
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/2815b121bfc5854251675ecf86c1f0de885e150f.png[/img]

notes.title: New Demo launches June 13th - Sign up to continue playing after Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey there Survivors! Are you ready to go on an adventure?

We are launching our brand new demo for Steam Next Fest on June 13th. It's going to include a brand new area to explore that's a total of 16 sq km with several new biomes. 

Over 25 new features added to the game plus bugfixes and more.

See all the changes on our post here: https://socksandgoats.com/blog/next-fest-update

More announcements to be announced on livestreams with Q&A with the dev.

See you there!

Want to keep playing or playtest after Next Fest, get updates and see our Roadmap?
Sign up here: [url=https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy]Join the Project Canopy Community[/url]

notes.title: Survival Foundations Update
notes.content:
[h2]What to look out for in this update?
[/h2]
- This wouldn’t be a survival update without survival stats, right? Oxygen, Hunger, Thirst, and Health have all been added to the game using our new framework.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/466f584aaa8b9817e0e9aed62b1e4a6e32cbee60.png[/img]
- Take the HoverBike for a spin to zip through the jungle faster than ever before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/5e64a3d2ddd5025b2aeb215e4b0521b6d7e499e1.png[/img]
- Look for the new massive creature roaming the vegetation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/b0c3eca828b1d1aaef91d4a064aa4c94a2c586dd.png[/img]
- New Starter Pod where you can replenish your oxygen, store and retrieve items from your personal container and a Fabricator to craft items hangs on the wall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/5e64a3d2ddd5025b2aeb215e4b0521b6d7e499e1.png[/img]
- Crashed Ships can be found around the map and usually have loot inside them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/d63c87f9a29b5a08087bfa3436793bfc0cd5c66b.png[/img]
- Some performance tweaks have been made so vegetation can be seen further.

notes.title: New Creature in Development - Swamp Bison
notes.content:
The Swamp Bison is so immersed in the thick jungle swamp that the vegetation and ecosystem grow on and around it. It only leaves the safety of the water to munch on nearby foliage.
[url=https://imgur.com/gallery/nQCyID8][img]https://i.imgur.com/7ipVALv.png[/img][/url]
